normal-equations.def: \(\bX\T\bX\hat\bbeta=\bX\T\by\): the linear system whose solution is the least-squares estimate; it says the residual vector is perpendicular to every column of \(\bX\).

correlation-matrix.def: A table of the correlations between every pair of variables; symmetric with 1s on the diagonal.

f-statistic.def: \(\frac{(\text{TSS}-\RSS)/p}{\RSS/(n-p-1)}\): tests whether at least one predictor is related to the response; about 1 if none is.

variable-selection.def: Choosing which subset of the predictors to keep in a model, e.g. by forward, backward or mixed selection.

prediction-interval.def: A range for a single new response \(y_0\) at given predictor values; wider than the confidence interval for the mean because it includes the irreducible error \(\epsilon\).
